Curiosity, grounded

I am Kishan Deka, a PhD researcher in cosmology at the National Centre for Nuclear Research (NCBJ), Warsaw.

AT A GLANCE

Warsaw, Poland
6+ years of Python
Cosmology & scientific computing

From research to real-world data

My work brings together CMB gravitational lensing, Galactic foregrounds, B-mode delensing, and cross-correlations with large-scale structure. I build simulation and analysis workflows to understand what noisy observations can tell us—and where uncertainty remains.

I am developing a portfolio in data science, machine learning, and analytics, applying the same emphasis on reproducibility, careful debugging, and statistical evaluation.

Skills, in context

Statistical modeling
Bayesian inference, likelihood analysis, uncertainty quantification, and correlation functions.
Scientific computing
Python, numerical simulations, large-scale data processing, and signal processing.
Machine learning projects
Classification, neural networks, explainability, and model evaluation.
Data engineering projects
SQL workflows, streaming architectures, reproducible environments, and CI/CD.
